title: Keith's loggia stands where its plan puts it
items: 1808 Prairie's loggia now stands on slimmer 0.6 m pedestals at the places the 1888 floor plan draws, its paired columns closer together, and the front stair narrowed to the plan's 1.8 m with its north wall running into the loggia.
In the 1888 engraving the rebuilt columns now land on the drawing's own; the 1965 photograph still reads each pair a little wider, which is the next thing to settle.
